nodes.label: Account (value or access holding)
nodes.def: A named holding of value or access, such as a bank account or a user account.

nodes.label: Approval Action
nodes.def: An action that formally accepts a request and releases it to proceed.

nodes.label: Delegation Action
nodes.def: An action that grants or passes authority to another actor.

nodes.label: Execute Action
nodes.def: An action that runs code, a command or a process in the environment.

nodes.label: Read Action
nodes.def: An action whose primary effect is to observe or retrieve without changing business state.

nodes.label: Authority revocation action
nodes.def: An action that removes or cancels an authority, credential or access that previously existed.

nodes.label: Value Transfer Action
nodes.def: An action that moves money or another measurable value out of the enterprise.

nodes.label: Write Action
nodes.def: An action that creates or modifies a stored business fact.

nodes.label: Agent
nodes.def: A goal-directed software actor that reasons and takes steps, alone or handing off to another agent.

nodes.label: Agent Identity
nodes.def: The identity an autonomous agent presents when it acts, distinct from the model instance behind it.

nodes.label: Authenticated Subject
nodes.def: The identity a request is proven to come from after verification, as opposed to one merely asserted.

nodes.label: Authority
nodes.def: The right to make a particular decision or cause a particular state change on behalf of the enterprise.

nodes.label: Authorization Scope
nodes.def: The boundary of what an authority permits: which resources, actions and amounts it covers.

nodes.label: Commitment
nodes.def: An obligation to deliver or pay, such as an order, refund or payment run.

nodes.label: Connector
nodes.def: A transport or adapter that exposes an external system's capabilities to an agent.

nodes.label: Consent
nodes.def: A subject permission that limits whether and how their data or authority may be used.

nodes.label: Credential Binding
nodes.def: A credential is bound to one identity and use so it cannot be replayed elsewhere.

nodes.label: Dual Approval
nodes.def: Two independent humans must each accept a high-impact action before it runs.

nodes.label: Continuous Monitoring
nodes.def: Ongoing observation that raises a signal when behaviour departs from the expected pattern.

nodes.label: Policy Gate
nodes.def: An automated rule evaluates a proposed action and can block or redact it.

nodes.label: Rate Limit
nodes.def: A cap on the rate or total volume of requests, items or resources a process may consume in a period.

nodes.label: Review Throttle
nodes.def: A limit on how many items may reach a human reviewer in a period, or an aggregation that batches them, so the review queue cannot be flooded.

nodes.label: Scope Limit
nodes.def: An action is confined to the resources and targets its authority covers.

nodes.label: Value Ceiling
nodes.def: A hard limit on the amount a process may move without additional review.

nodes.label: Authentication credential
nodes.def: A secret or token that proves an identity and can be replayed or stolen if mishandled.

nodes.label: Delegation
nodes.def: The act of passing authority to another actor, and the record of how far that authority travelled.

nodes.label: Authority Grant Effect
nodes.def: An identity gains a right it did not previously hold.

nodes.label: Authority removal
nodes.def: An authority, credential or access an identity held is removed or cancelled.

nodes.label: Configuration Change Effect
nodes.def: A setting, permission or integration is altered from its approved state.

nodes.label: Data Disclosure Effect
nodes.def: Data reaches a party that was not entitled to see it.

nodes.label: Data Read Effect
nodes.def: Business state changes only in that data was observed.

nodes.label: Data Write Effect
nodes.def: Business state changes because a stored fact was created or updated.

nodes.label: Record Alteration Effect
nodes.def: A stored fact is changed in a way that no longer matches the event that produced it.

nodes.label: Service Disruption Effect
nodes.def: A business service becomes unavailable or degraded.

nodes.label: Access entitlement (general)
nodes.def: A granted right or threshold that determines what an identity may do.

nodes.label: Approval Record

nodes.label: Attestation
nodes.def: A signed statement from a party that a condition holds.

nodes.label: Authorization Record
nodes.def: A record of the authority an action was permitted to use.

nodes.label: Configuration-change evidence
nodes.def: A record of a setting or permission change and who made it.

nodes.label: Data-access evidence
nodes.def: A record of which subject read which data, and when.

nodes.label: Identity Assertion
nodes.def: A claim about who a subject is, and the proof shown for it.

nodes.label: Observation
nodes.def: A raw observed event from the runtime graph that has not been adjudicated.

nodes.label: Value Transfer Record
nodes.def: A record of value moving, with its amount, parties and time.

nodes.label: Runtime environment

nodes.label: Guardrail
nodes.def: A rule or policy engine that decides whether a proposed action may proceed.

nodes.label: Agent hand-off channel
nodes.def: A mechanism through which one agent passes a task and its authority to another.

nodes.label: Hazard
nodes.def: A condition that makes a harmful outcome possible and calls for a control and evidence.

nodes.label: Human decision point
nodes.def: A named human decision point that can stop or release an otherwise automatic action.

nodes.label: Human User
nodes.def: A person who authenticates and acts directly, or on whose behalf an agent acts.

nodes.label: Identity Provider
nodes.def: A service that issues or brokers the identities and credentials an actor uses.

nodes.label: Initiative
nodes.def: A planned or running enterprise effort with an intended business result.

nodes.label: Memory
nodes.def: State an agent carries between steps or across runs, and can later read back.

nodes.label: Accountability
nodes.def: Every decision can be traced to the actor and authority behind it.

nodes.label: Authorized Action
nodes.def: Every state change is backed by authority that covers it.

nodes.label: Availability

nodes.label: Confidentiality
nodes.def: Information is readable only by parties entitled to it.

nodes.label: Integrity
nodes.def: Stored facts keep matching the events that produced them.

nodes.label: Safe Completion

nodes.label: Contact Data Shared Without Consent
nodes.def: Contact details are reused for a purpose the subject did not consent to.

nodes.label: Discount Approved Beyond Authority
nodes.def: A quote discount is released above the level the approver may grant.

nodes.label: Lead Data Taken From An Unverified Source
nodes.def: Lead enrichment ingests records from a third-party source the enterprise has not vetted, so data from a compromised supply chain can enter the pipeline.

nodes.label: Duplicate Invoice Submission
nodes.def: The invoice-approval tool is invoked twice for the same invoice, so it is paid as if it were two obligations.

nodes.label: Payment Above Approved Ceiling
nodes.def: A value transfer exceeds the amount the workflow is authorised to release automatically.

nodes.label: Journal Adjustment Without Second Review
nodes.def: A journal entry is altered after approval so the books no longer match the event.

nodes.label: Payment From Unverified Instruction
nodes.def: A payment instruction reaches release without independent proof of who sent it.

nodes.label: Excessive Access Granted On Day One
nodes.def: A new joiner receives more access than the role needs at the moment of onboarding.

nodes.label: Offer Terms Altered After Approval
nodes.def: The agent context holding an approved offer is altered after sign-off, so the terms it issues are not the ones that were approved.

nodes.label: Pay Change Without Approval
nodes.def: The payroll-adjustment tool is invoked before an independent approver has seen the change.

nodes.label: Credential Reused Across Agents
nodes.def: One credential is shared by several agents so its use cannot be attributed.

nodes.label: Orphaned Account After Offboarding
nodes.def: An account survives the offboarding that should have removed it.

nodes.label: Entitlement Left Standing After Role Change
nodes.def: Access that a former role justified remains granted after the role changes.

nodes.label: Access Granted Without Matching Authority
nodes.def: A role or entitlement is granted beyond the scope the approver held.

nodes.label: Outside Counsel Receives Excess Material
nodes.def: Material beyond the scope of the engagement is shared with outside counsel.

nodes.label: Filing Sent With Unreviewed Change
nodes.def: The filing tool is invoked to submit a regulatory filing while a change to it is still unreviewed.

nodes.label: Privileged Material Retrieved Without Screening
nodes.def: Content that should stay inside the matter is selected and surfaced.

nodes.label: Bank Detail Change From Unverified Instruction
nodes.def: Supplier bank details are changed on the strength of an instruction nobody independently confirmed.

nodes.label: Three-way Match Bypassed
nodes.def: The payment tool is invoked although goods receipt, order and invoice do not agree.

nodes.label: Purchase Order Split Below Approval Threshold
nodes.def: One purchase is broken into several orders that each stay under the review threshold.

nodes.label: Supplier Details Confirmed By Same Requester
nodes.def: The requester acts as the independent confirmer of a supplier change, impersonating the second party the control expects.

nodes.label: Account Recovery Without Verified Identity
nodes.def: Account recovery proceeds on evidence weaker than the account it restores.

nodes.label: Poisoned Knowledge Article Retrieved
nodes.def: A knowledge article with tampered content is selected into the answer.

nodes.label: Customer Data Sent To Unverified Requester
nodes.def: Customer data is returned to a requester whose identity was only asserted.

nodes.label: Repeated Refund After Partial Failure
nodes.def: A partially failed refund is retried and the value leaves more than once.

nodes.label: Unrecoverable Payout
nodes.def: An effect rather than a business entity: it names what a payment action produced, not a thing the enterprise owns.

nodes.label: Unauthorised Pay Change
nodes.def: An effect of a compensation record being changed without the approval the change requires, so the stored fact no longer matches the authorised instruction.

nodes.label: Standing Privilege
nodes.def: A condition of an entitlement that persists after its justification ends, so it is modelled as a state.

nodes.label: Unverified Bank Change
nodes.def: An effect of a supplier bank-detail field being updated without the independent evidence the change requires; the write is real, only its verification is missing, so it is not record corruption.

nodes.def: An effect of a disclosure action, classified as an outcome of the process rather than a stored record.
